outcome: Behavioural outcomes (Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire (SDQ) total difficulties and clinically significant difficulties)
ADHD-RS hyperactivity impulsivity z-scores and clinically significant difficulties
Social Communication Questionnaire (SCQ) scores and clinically significant difficulties
cohort: The participants were two national cohorts of children born extremely preterm in 1995 (EPICure) and 2006 (EPICure2), along with matched term-born children, all assessed at approximately 11 years of age.
finding: Behavioural outcomes for children born extremely preterm have not improved between the 1995 and 2006 cohorts, and relative to term-born peers, the 2006 EP cohort showed worse outcomes than the 1995 EP cohort.
